what: PhysioGaitNorm: Normative Gait Reference Database for the Physio Ecosystem — PhysioGaitNorm-package
title: PhysioGaitNorm: Normative Gait Reference Database for the Physio Ecosystem — PhysioGaitNorm-package
text: Normative gait reference data Physio ecosystem: mean standard-deviation kinematic waveform bands gait cycle (51- 101-point) nine Gait Deviation Index / Gait Profile Score kinematic variables, together normative feature reference set constructing Gait Deviation Index. Provides dataset loaders, catalogue, documented provenance version manifest. bundled "adult_reference" set representative healthy-adult normative model derived published normal gait kinematics (Perry & Burnfield; Winter; Kadaba et al.) synthetic normative feature population; see provenance manifest citations. Consumed gait-index calculations (Schwartz & Rozumalski 2008 GDI; Baker et al. 2009 GPS/GVS/MAP).

code: loadGaitNorm(   dataset = "adult_reference",   cycle = c(101, 51),   age = NULL,   speed = NULL,   features = TRUE,   reload = FALSE )

title: Load a normative gait reference dataset — loadGaitNorm
text: dataset Dataset name; one listGaitNorms()$dataset (default "adult_reference"). cycle Gait-cycle length points: 101 (default) 51. age Optional age years; given must fall within dataset's age_min/age_max, otherwise error raised (reference set stratified age). speed Optional walking-speed condition (e.g. "self_selected"); given must match dataset's speed. features Logical; TRUE (default) also load normative feature reference matrix (subjects x concatenated 51-point kinematics) used build GDI basis. reload Logical; force re-read even dataset cached.

title: Load a normative gait reference dataset — loadGaitNorm
text: gait_norm list elements: dataset, version, cycle_length, percent (cycle sampling points), variables, mean sd (length(variables) x cycle_length matrix, rows named variable, columns named cycle percentage), units, features (feature matrix NULL), provenance (one-row manifest data frame).

PhysioGaitNorm 0.1.1
text: Added VAL-11 verification (test-published-norms.R): bundled adult_reference sagittal joint-angle bands checked reproduce published healthy-adult normative landmarks derived (Perry & Burnfield 2010; Winter 1991; Kadaba et al. 1990) – peak knee flexion ~60 deg swing, hip flexion/extension ROM ~40 deg, ankle dorsi/plantarflexion ROM ~28 deg, anterior pelvic tilt ~11 deg. public gait databases (GaitRec, Gutenberg) contain ground reaction forces, joint kinematics, bands validated published normative ranges rather recomputed raw kinematics. MANIFEST provenance updated accordingly.
